decisions.reason: The vacuum thermoforming unit builds directly on the firm's long-standing dental and earmold lab equipment know-how, has its own page in both years, and its results are easy for the firm to interpret and improve through in-house R&D.

The orthopedic shoe last extends the firm's digital manufacturing and custom-fit competence into a new orthopedic field where its prior knowledge is weaker, but it was launched only recently with its own page, so it deserves more time for the firm to learn from early results.

The post-curing unit complements the firm's 3D printing resins and digital workflows, which it understands well, so it fits the integrated-system strategy even though it is only mentioned on the website so far.
